audience: teams who collect responses with Formstack forms

useCases.title: Count responses to a form by day
useCases.text: The AI lists forms with their submission counts and counts one form's submissions with a per-day breakdown over a window of up to 7 days.

useCases.title: Read the latest submissions of a form
useCases.text: The AI lists a form's submissions filtered by keyword, date range or field values, with the answers. It sums up what people wrote.

useCases.title: Find everything a person submitted
useCases.text: The AI runs a full-text search across all forms, for example by an email or name, and opens each submission.

useCases.title: Find people who did not finish a form
useCases.text: The AI lists the partial submissions of a form, the entries that were started but not finished.

useCases.title: Correct a submission or create a prefilled link
useCases.text: The AI changes field values on an existing submission, or creates a link to a form with some fields filled in for a customer.
